item.title: What Edu is reading this week (Sep 12 - 19, 2026)
item.description: Agent infrastructure dominated the week: Kubernetes-native harnesses, a high-density sandbox runtime on GKE, and a 27B model compressed into under 6 GB. Alongside that, BSD filesystem work, PipeWire audio tooling and a batch of retro-gaming archives. AI, Agents & Tools llmman - Runs any agent on any model, with the models themselves stored and shipped as OCI images. Mecatl - Stacklok’s open source, cloud-native harness for agents: the agent loop, the sandbox and the state are separate components, so a fleet runs on Kubernetes instead of on your laptop.
